rows.resolution_note: Rule C: sentence 2 of p001 gives the authors' own analysis of UK Biobank individual-level data, defined by a measurement (2,941 plasma proteins) and an ancestry beyond the number of participants, and sentence 3 says the authors ran their own GWAS of the proteins; 43,978 equals no dictionary row's N and no release identifier or citation is given.
rows.quote: METHODS: We analysed 2,941 plasma proteins in 43,978 European participants from UK Biobank.
